user.title: Monitored space
user.description: Pick the sensors for a room or your whole home. Only indoor temperature is required; every extra sensor makes suggestions better.

data.name: Name
data.aq_lower_is_better: Lower air quality reading is better

data_description.co2: Only open doors/windows and extractor fans lower CO2 faster than normal. Also used to estimate how many people are home.
data_description.air_quality: Particulates/VOC. If this improves while CO2 does not, an aircon or purifier filter is working.
data_description.solar_threshold: When it is warming indoors and outdoor temperature is at or above this, it's the sun; below it, heat is leaking in from outside.

menu.title: Appliances
menu.description:
Add the heaters, aircons, extractor fans, dehumidifiers and purifiers in this space. You can add more later from Configure.

data.power_on: Running power (per fan for fan groups)
data.inverter: Inverter / modulating (keeps running at reduced power at setpoint)
data.hold_factor: Idle power factor (share of rated power while holding setpoint)
data.count: Number of fans in this group
data.members: Fan names, comma separated (e.g. Bathroom, Kitchen, Laundry)
data.power_entity: Power sensor of its smart plug

data_description.members: Name them so each can be calibrated and identified; left blank they're Fan 1, Fan 2...
data_description.airflow_m3h: Used until you calibrate. Typical: bathroom 90, kitchen hood 300-600.
data_description.power_entity: Its learned heat and moisture effect is removed before HVAC detection, so e.g. a tumble dryer isn't mistaken for heating or a humidifier.

hvac_functions.title: {name}: what can it do?
hvac_functions.description: Heat adds a heat mode. Air condition adds cool and dehumidify (dry). Ventilate adds fresh-air ventilation (lowers CO2) and indoor filter/recirculation (cleans particulates, not CO2).

teach.name: Teach
teach.description: Tell the integration what is actually happening now.

label.name: Label
label.description: Label key or display name, as shown in the Actual mode select.

reset_learning.name: Reset learning
reset_learning.description: Forget everything learned for this space.

set_manual.name: Set manual mode
set_manual.description: Set what an appliance is doing and/or its setpoint.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: auto to go back to inference.

fans_on.name: Fans on
fans_on.description: Extractor fan groups: how many are running while in manual mode.

calibrate.name: Calibrate appliance
calibrate.description: Record what an appliance is doing right now. Multiple calibrations are combined.

fans.name: Fans running
fans.description: Extractor fan groups: names of the fans running right now (calibrate one at a time to identify each).

fans_on.name: Number of fans running
fans_on.description: Extractor fan groups: how many are running right now (0 = none).

calibrate_occupancy.name: Calibrate occupancy
calibrate_occupancy.description: Tell the CO2 model how many people are home and what they are doing.

people.name: People
people.description: 0 while nobody is home teaches the natural air change rate.

activity.name: Activity
activity.description: Defaults to the current activity level.

reset_energy.name: Reset energy
reset_energy.description: Zero the energy counter of an appliance (or all in a space).
